verdict.rationale: Graphite ships a built-in AI assistant you can delegate work to. Its Agents take plain-language requests, pull repo context, generate changes and open a draft PR (graphite-docs-12, graphite-docs-22). Graphite Chat explains PRs, diagnoses failing CI and applies one-click fixes (graphite-docs-29, graphite-docs-7, graphite-docs-8, graphite-docs-21), and Graphite Agent reviews new PRs automatically (graphite-docs-19). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated agent tasks work well in practice, since community posts only confirm that AI features exist in the review UI.
